Internal helper: jrelabel()'s note on the labels kept (ruling R37)

Source: R/recode.R
dot-jst_relabel_kept_note.Rd

"Note: The declared missing values of Education kept their labels:" and, on an indented line of its own, the values – each in the form jfreq()'s Missing rows use (.jst_udm_row_label()), a code as .jst_fmt_code() gives it, a marker by its letter (.a) – as the load narrative lists a variable's declared values. On a line of their own the values start at the margin, where in the sentence a wrap could part -99 from its label. Variables keeping the same labels share one note; a variable with one such value "kept its label". At the standard and full output levels, as jrelabel()'s other lines. Session 391.

Usage

.jst_relabel_kept_note(kept)

Arguments

kept

Named list: for each variable that kept labels, the .jst_declared_labels_kept() result.

Value

Character(1), the notes one blank line apart, or NULL.
